# Security Requirements Checklist: Security Audit Remediation

**Purpose**: Validate the completeness, clarity, consistency, and measurability of the remediation requirements before implementation (requirements quality, not control verification).
**Created**: 2026-10-31
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: Generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command from the feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Is each confirmed audit finding (`familytree:api:no-authn`, `familytree:dev-server:fs-deny-overridden-project-files-readable`) covered by at least one functional requirement? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the interim containment (loopback default, `HOST` override) specified for the period before feature 003 lands? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK003 Are all unauthenticated `/api` routes enumerated or otherwise guaranteed by a requirement that new routes cannot ship unguarded? [Completeness, Contract api-access]
- [ ] CHK004 Are dev-server requirements complete for config merge, Host allowlist, dot-directory deny and process-exit behaviour? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, Contract dev-server]
- [ ] CHK005 Is a requirement defined for removing unused authentication and database dependencies? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK006 Are requirements defined for the rejected dependency lead (hygiene, not finding) so it is neither lost nor over-claimed? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 Is "explicit allowlist" for Vite `allowedHosts` defined with concrete allowed values? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK008 Is "bounded" quantified (maximum count, length and numeric range) for `memberIds`, free text and position values? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-005, §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK009 Is "generic message" for 5xx responses defined precisely enough to test? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK010 Is "PII" in logs defined (which fields must never be logged)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK011 Are the rate-limit thresholds for read versus mutating routes quantified? [Gap, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK012 Is "explicitly forced" defined for `cleanup`/`seed` in production? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-009]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK013 Do the header requirements in this spec align with 013 FR-004 without duplicate or conflicting definitions? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the loopback default consistent with the Replit deployment requirement for a reachable port? [Conflict, Spec §FR-001, Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK015 Are the severity statements in `audit-report.md` consistent with the full-run results (medium, low, rejected)? [Consistency, Audit report]
- [ ] CHK016 Is SC-004 ("SEC-001…SEC-010") consistent with the fingerprint-based findings and the traceability table? [Consistency, Spec §SC-004]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK017 Can each functional requirement be objectively verified by a test or command listed in the quickstart? [Measurability, Spec §FR-001–FR-012]
- [ ] CHK018 Is the audit gate in SC-002 defined for residual advisories (owner, rationale, expiry)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK019 Is success for the dev-server requirement stated as observable results (403s, process stays up)? [Measurability, Contract dev-server]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK020 Are exception requirements defined for invalid `memberIds` shapes (object, array of objects, truncated integers)? [Coverage, Edge Case, Contract input-validation]
- [ ] CHK021 Are requirements defined for infinite or out-of-range position values? [Coverage, Edge Case, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK022 Are recovery or rollback requirements defined if a dependency upgrade breaks behaviour? [Gap, Recovery]
- [ ] CHK023 Is behaviour specified for existing stored data that violates the new bounds (long text, non-http photo URLs)? [Gap, Edge Case]

## Non-Functional & Security Requirements

- [ ] CHK024 Are authorization (not only authentication) requirements stated per route, with 401 vs 403 semantics? [Completeness, Contract api-access]
- [ ] CHK025 Are logging requirements limited to exclude secrets and PII while preserving diagnosability? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK026 Are DB transport security requirements (TLS configuration) specified for production? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK027 Are performance and availability expectations of rate limiting stated (false-positive tolerance)? [Gap]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK028 Is the dependency on feature 003 for authentication and on 013 for CI gates stated with the interim behaviour? [Dependency, Spec §Related]
- [ ] CHK029 Is the unverified assumption about public deployment and real data documented with its owner and resolution? [Assumption, Audit report §Needs validation]
- [ ] CHK030 Is the advisory data limitation (offline check) documented with a resolution step? [Assumption, Research]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK031 Is it clear that the `**/.*/**` deny addition requires confirmation by test before being treated as the fix? [Ambiguity, Research]
- [ ] CHK032 Is the requirement ID scheme (FR-xxx, SEC-xxx, fingerprints) mapped so that references are unambiguous? [Traceability, Spec §Finding Traceability]
